nameTypePolicy.title: Name types for auto-tagging
nameTypePolicy.intro: Phase 1 = first Tag bomb pass. Phase 2 = short-form pass after people are linked. Never = stored but never auto-tagged (e.g. family names).
nameTypePolicy.primary_warning: Primary names are usually tagged in Phase 1. Setting Primary to Phase 2 or Never may leave many person mentions untagged on the first pass.
nameTypePolicy.art_length_hint: Length-gated: short art names go to Phase 2 (≥ {{count}} code points → Phase 1)
nameTypePolicy.custom_intro: Project-specific types (ASCII id slug). They follow the same Phase 1 / Phase 2 / Never rules.
